the irish cancer society is seeking compassionate volunteer drivers to join our transport team. we are currently looking for drivers in kerry, particularly those who can drive to ho spitals in limerick. if you can spare 2 days per month, have a valid driving licence, and a safe , reliable vehicle, you are the perfect candidate to make a difference. the irish cancer society provides training and support before you begin volunteering. your time can make a meaningful difference, providing practical support and reassurance to patients when they need it most. for more information please contact monica or emily at
